name: Manappuram Finance Limited
summary: Manappuram Finance Limited, a gold loan non-banking financial company, provides fund-based and fee-based financial services in India. It operates through Gold Loan and Others, and Microfinance segments. The company offers loans, such as gold loans, gold loans at your doorstep, online gold loans, business loans, home improvement loans, housing loans, property loans, income-generating loans, and personal loans; balance transfers and top-ups; and co-lending arrangements. It also finances commercial and passenger vehicles, construction and farm equipment, and two-wheelers, as well as micro, small, and medium enterprises.
